title: Chapter 245 Invitation
content:
Chapter 245 Invitation

They still clearly remember that dozens of soldiers in front were directly killed when their general swung the knife down.

I clearly remember that the enemy's general waved the hammer in his hand and smashed it heavily on the ground. A large pit more than ten meters deep appeared on the ground, and the coalition soldiers there were also turned into meat paste.

Such terrifying strength, when it really appeared, made these soldiers feel heartbroken, and they were so horrified that they didn't even have the courage to fight.

After that, on the battlefield, those who were so frightened that they could not even hold their weapons steadily had already died on the ground, and the soldiers who were able to recover became the elite and survived.

Those who survived, that is, these soldiers who were guarding the camp, were deeply in awe of the strength of these people and the divine power contained in their bodies.

And before they accepted the guard order, they had been reminded by their superiors that many of these people in front of them were masters with the strength of a ten thousand husband, that is, first-class strength in the world.

And the rest are also strong players who can instantly fight tens of hundreds of people, their strength is far higher than them, so why not make them feel nervous and afraid!

Fortunately, for the past three days, the people inside didn't make any big moves. Instead, they stayed inside obediently, and didn't embarrass the soldiers outside.

It also made them breathe a sigh of relief, glad that their lives were saved for another day.

Behind these soldiers, there was a clatter of horseshoes, and several knights who were attacking head-on, followed by those knights pulling the reins, stopped and stood with a groan.

Hearing the sound behind him, the commander-in-chief of the 3,000-strong army, that is, a 1,000-man general of the coalition army, turned his head to look, his frowning brows suddenly eased, and a rare joy appeared on his face.

"It turned out to be several adults, and the adults came here, but it was the order of the king?"

It turned out that the knights who came here on horseback were all Zhong Yu's personal bodyguards, and each of them was not low in rank, and they were all generals.

Although the commanders and horses of these people are not as good as this thousand-strong general, isn't there a saying that has been said? All the officials in front of the Son of Heaven's Gate had to be treated differently, what's more, these people who served King Jing and casually said a few words would have a fatal impact on the future of this thousand-strong general. Naturally, this thousand-strong general would not dare to neglect.

"That's right, the king ordered me to come and meet some distinguished guests!" The knight nodded arrogantly, but he didn't care much about the general in front of him whose rank was higher than his own.

Being treated so contemptuously by the person in front of him, although the general was annoyed, he dared not speak out, endured it, and ordered his subordinates to make way.

Seeing that the general was so knowledgeable, several knights put away the arrogance on their faces, all got off their horses, with some respectful expressions on their faces, lined up neatly together, embraced the leading knight, and came to the camp.

"How many distinguished guests? The king has an order, please have an audience!" The leading knight walked to the door, through the drawn curtain of the tent, as if shouting from inside, with a very respectful tone.

There was no echo in the camp, and it was still silent. After a long time, about two or three quarters, the knight still did not hear any echo.

At this moment, some soldiers around were showing anger, especially the 3,000 troops on the outskirts. Although they didn't have much feeling for King Jing above them, they were loyal to His Majesty the Emperor. The identity of the superior is extremely loyal.

Now seeing the envoys sent by the emperor's younger brother being so contemptuous by these reckless people in front of them, their dignity as soldiers of the empire and their loyalty to the emperor made them very angry.

However, although they were annoyed, the commander of the knights did not show the slightest expression, his face was still respectful and calm, and he continued to speak when he heard that there was no sound inside.

"Dear guests, I hope you will forgive me for being negligent for a long time. It's just that the king has ordered me to invite you to share my apology!"

The respectful voice came into the tent again, but this time inside the tent, it was not like before, there was no movement at all.

With his legs crossed and his hands on his knees, the farm leader Tian Guang, who was in a meditation posture, heard the voice of the man outside the tent again, and finally slowly opened his eyes. He drew a long air sword, breathed a sigh of relief, and said to Xiaoyaozi who was opposite him.

"Brother Xiaoyao, it's the second time, I don't know..."

When Xiaoyaozi heard Tian Guang's question, he also opened his eyes, pondered for a while, and said.

"It's ok, just now, I've actually neglected a bit, and I'm just taking this opportunity to vent my depression, that's all, if I continue, it will be too much!" Xiaoyaozi weighed in his heart for a while, and did Made this decision.

"Brother Xiaoyao is right. I was invited here by more than 1,000 cavalry sent by that King Jing before. For three days and three nights, no one was seen, and we were just trapped here. It is so unreasonable to be so contemptuous! I ignored it just now, but it was justified. But if I continue to do it, after all, that person represents the Lord of the Allied Forces of the Six Nations, His Royal Highness Prince Jing of the Imperial Kingdom. It’s not good!” Master Ban also said.

Previously, Xiaoyaozi and the others watched the battlefield below from the cliff, constantly observing the balance of power between the two sides, and deducing the development of the general trend of the world.

Clinker, Xiaoyaozi and others who were sitting on the hill, were unexpectedly surrounded by more than a thousand cavalry from the coalition army, and the siege was airtight.

Surrounded by the military camps of the Imperial Kingdom, they dare not fight directly, attracting more troops to encircle and suppress them, so they can only follow the wishes of these cavalrymen, follow them to the camp, and see this one who wants to see them King Jing.

But he thought that when he came to the barracks, he would be able to meet Prince Jing whom he was looking forward to. How could he have imagined that the majestic leaders of his faction, the famous figures in the world, would be left here for three days and three nights.

There are thousands of soldiers guarding around him day and night, guarding himself like a thief, treating himself as a prisoner, so how can he not make such noble people as Xiaoyaozi feel angry.

That's why people like Xiaoyaozi made the move just now. They didn't answer the cavalry commander's first question, and just left him alone.

But after the cavalry commander's second invitation came out, people like Xiaoyaozi didn't dare to push too much. If this continues, both sides will become angry.

When the time comes to fight, people like myself in the barracks will definitely suffer, and even find it difficult to escape.
